```python
def refundable(self) -> bool:
```

Gift cards are left out of the refundable total. An order that contains only gift cards and final-sale items gets the `no_refundable_items` blocker. `test_final_sale_and_gift_cards_never_qualify` in `backend/tests/test_rules.py` covers this.
